The keeper-golden tooling payload for the omarchy channel bases: acpid (fast
ACPI shutdown — channel evals shut down in seconds, not the graceful-stop
grace), qemu-guest-agent (consistent snapshots + console fallback), and a
FULL PACKAGE UPDATE so every channel golden carries current packages at
capture. Composed by all four keeper beds (stable/rc/edge/dev); mutating
steps run at deploy ONCE at capture.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | install acpid + qemu-guest-agent and update all packages (current golden) |
| `check` | acpid is enabled |
| `check` | qemu-guest-agent is enabled |
